rules.description: The algorithm must be tested on sample data before the final merit list is prepared.
rules.condition: Prior to preparing the final merit list for all three scholarship schemes.
rules.outcome: The algorithm is first tested on a sample data; the final merit list must be prepared by 15th October 2017.
rules.evidence_quote: algorithm will be first tested on a sample data before preparing the final Merit list by 15th October, 2017 for all three scholarship schemes.

rules.description: If any state/UT‑wise quota for a particular community remains unutilised after the merit list is generated, the unutilised quota is re‑allocated to the same community in other states/UTs proportionately from the remaining completely verified applications, ordered by merit.
rules.condition: After generation of the merit list, when the state/UT‑wise quota under a particular community remains unutilised.
rules.outcome: The unutilised quota is first distributed amongst the same community of the remaining States/UTs proportionately from the remaining completely verified applications in order of merit.
rules.evidence_quote: In case after generation of Merit list, the state/UT-wise quota under a particular community remains unutilised, the same shall be first distributed amongst the same community of the remaining States/UTs proportionately from amongst the remaining completely verified applications in order of merit.

rules.description: If the quota for a community still remains unutilised after the first redistribution, the remaining quota is distributed among other communities across all states/UTs proportionately from the remaining completely verified applications, ordered by merit.
rules.condition: After the first redistribution, when the quota against a community still remains unutilised.
rules.outcome: The remaining quota is distributed amongst the other communities of all the States/UTs proportionately from the remaining completely verified applications in order of merit.
rules.evidence_quote: In case the quota against a community still remains unutilised, the same shall be distributed amongst the other communities of all the States/UTs proportionately from amongst the remaining completely verified applications in order of merit.
